# VDO.Ninja native SDK

Source: https://github.com/steveseguin/ninjasdk

Pinned commit: `5d658603ef68c80d7d771cf3092500bbc4df9e93`.
The Kotlin core and Android sources are under `app/src/main/kotlin/ninja/vdo/sdk`.
They retain their MPL-2.0 notices and are distributed in source form with this project.
See `LICENSE` and upstream `LICENSING.md` in this directory.

Extend requires explicit viewer passwords, hardware H.264 and a single viewer.
Local SDK changes for those boundaries are documented alongside the relevant code.
The SDK license does not guarantee availability of the hosted signaling or relay services.
